scope: Root-observed native Tauri continuation of the remaining 36 findings; separate original P1 Pay Later timeout recovery
recordedBy: Root agent native observations; report assembly by settings agent, which did not control native UI

checks.nativeBundle: Final normal debug macOS bundle built without the test fault flag and launched successfully
checks.note: Final scopes are not additive. Frontend 56 skips include 54 real-MariaDB cases separately passed (42 catalogue + 9 attendance + 3 stock-count SQL), plus 2 other optional cases not run. Rust 10 filtered cases include the generic-stock MariaDB replay separately passed, plus 9 other optional cases not run. Real database total 55 excludes 14 additional unit cases.

findings.native: Native held QA customer accepted a 200p opening balance and a 100p historical increase without enabling purchases. A 300p cash repayment cleared the balance while the hold remained in place. The final native account view showed Allow Pay Later purchases unchecked, status On hold, balance 0p and points 0.
findings.limits: Observed local historical-debt/repayment workflow passed. Shared-MariaDB first-writer concurrency and custom-role authorization rejection were not native UI tested; automated policy checks remain separate.

findings.native: Configured native setup exposed Cancel — Back to Settings and returned to Advanced Settings without committing a mode or credential change.
findings.limits: Configured, authenticated success path observed. Initial setup, pending restore, inactive authentication and running-operation cancellation exclusions are isolated guard tests, not additional native scenarios.

findings.native: Native VCMLABJTIP0 sandbox recovery obtained definitive Canceled proof for customer attempt 5bf39884 (300p) and checkout attempt 02873c32 (169p). Neither produced a charge; order count remained 91.
findings.limits: Dojo sandbox only. Fresh final provider/journal proof, rather than a cancellation-request acknowledgement, established these outcomes. Late capture, Live/Unknown exclusion and uncertain-result branches are automated fixtures, not native live-payment certification.

findings.native: A newly saved native customer had its missing held account initialized by a 200p opening post. A subsequent 100p increase and 300p cash repayment succeeded; balance returned to zero without changing its purchase hold.
findings.limits: Native local account initialization/ledger workflow passed. MariaDB simultaneous first-writer behavior and unauthorized/invalid rollback branches were not exercised through the native UI.

findings.native: Native Back Office order history with 91 populated records displayed receipt buttons within the first column instead of clipping them.
findings.limits: Observed populated square-screen layout passed. This is not a complete receipt-number-length, zoom or every supported resolution matrix.

findings.native: Native new-customer form save closed the on-screen keyboard instead of leaving it orphaned over the next view.
findings.limits: Customer form-save path only. Attendance/design modal closure and cross-page navigation are covered by source/target-eligibility fixtures but were not individually native verified.

findings.native: No native provider-switch failure was injected and no saved provider key or configuration was changed. Confirmed-state recovery is covered by seven provider helper cases plus native source review.
findings.limits: Recoverable two-provider sequence, not an atomic cross-provider transaction. Before rollback, production rereads the prior provider after an ambiguous write failure; mocked tests cover confirmed-enabled, confirmed-disabled and unreadable outcomes. Native filesystem faults/failed-save branches are not a native PASS; uncertain configurations require reload/confirmation.

findings.native: Native font selection saved the L&Bj default choice, then saved the original Legacy choice again and confirmed restoration.
findings.limits: Healthy font saves/restoration were observed. Older-save rejection, rapid overlapping choice order and durable audit failure were simulated in isolated fixtures, not injected into native Tauri.

findings.native: Native label selection retained one chosen label until explicit Clear. Print was disabled because no printer was configured.
findings.limits: No native OS print dialog opened, so OS cancellation retention is automated-only. Native selection and explicit Clear were observed; no physical label print was sent.

findings.native: Native tax default changed Zero → Standard → Zero through the atomic save path. Original default was restored, two tax rates remained and four related audit records were retained.
findings.limits: Healthy atomic snapshot saves and restoration passed in native Tauri. Compare-and-set conflicts, concurrent editors and commit rejection remain automated checks rather than native fault injection.

findings.native: Native Test Connection and Save & Reconnect Only succeeded on the configured till without entering import, forced-upload or cache-rebuild UI. Counts remained 91 orders, 855 customers and 2 tax rates.
findings.limits: Observed healthy same-target reconnect preserved data counts. Failed candidate, post-save failure/rollback, changed-server identity and restore branches were isolated/source tests, not native failures; absence of destructive UI is not a full tracing claim for every server operation.

findings.native: The native customer-account Dojo TIP0 payment displayed Cancel Terminal. An on-screen request returned without an account charge; later final provider/journal verification established Canceled.
findings.limits: Observed sandbox customer cancellation workflow passed without going to a physical terminal. Final-state wording in the latest rebuild was source verified, not captured again natively. Live card cancellation, late capture and uncertain recovery remain separate automated/provider certification scopes.

findings.native: Native feedback toggles saved confirmed off/on values and restored the original setting. Font saves also confirmed the selected value and restored Legacy. Failed saves are no longer treated as confirmed by the shared batch path.
findings.limits: Native healthy save paths observed. Seven production-function VM tests execute batching/audit policy with mocked transaction boundaries; before-read failure, atomic commit rejection, audit sanitization and publication ordering were not native fault injected. Scale/printer/tax failure paths are not blanket native PASS.

findings.native: Generate PLU editor-generation and delayed-result protection passed isolated production-handler fixtures; no native delayed PLU result was induced.
findings.limits: Native close/reopen, same-ID editor reuse and image-read races remain unobserved. Automated stale-generation proof is not a native UI PASS.

findings.native: Native Goods dialog initially focused Close, Tab reached search and Escape closed it. Native item editor initially focused Name and Escape closed it.
findings.limits: Initial focus, traversal and dismissal observed. Accessibility clicks on openers did not establish keyboard focus, so opener-focus restoration was not native verified; nested pad and full focus-cycle/inertness checks remain source/isolated coverage.

findings.native: Native Edit Item for 0EGGS (barcode 5020379111201, old-item-016480) started at stock 0, item tracking off, price 169p. With global stock tracking temporarily on, enabling item tracking and Save Item counted 0→1; UI and database confirmed stock 1/tracking on with queue 0, conflicts 0, intents 0. Reopening, counting 1→0 and disabling item tracking restored stock 0/tracking off/price 169p. Exactly two stock_counted audit rows recorded 0→1 and1→0 with the original expected-count CAS values. Global tracking was restored off.
findings.limits: Native healthy count/save and exact restoration passed; native stale-count races, audit failure, cache failure and uncertain COMMIT were not injected. Actual production SQL and native batch/CAS/generic-replay tests cover those boundaries separately. Details and stock remain separate commits with explicit partial-success handling. Shared counted-stock writes intentionally require online authority; legacy queued absolute counts need review/recount, not blind replay.

findings.native: Native tax snapshot saves succeeded. Repeated-click submission and hardware transport overlap protection passed isolated handler tests.
findings.limits: Actual double-click races were mocked, not native induced. Receipt/label/drawer tests are AUTOMATED_ONLY at mocked transport boundaries; no physical printer or drawer job/pulse was sent. Healthy tax saves do not prove duplicate-click or hardware safety natively.

findings.native: Native scale designer moved the apple later without saving; sidebar Settings triggered the unsaved-change warning. Cancel kept the draft. The apple was moved earlier and Save restored the original order.
findings.limits: Observed dirty sidebar navigation, Cancel and save/restoration passed. Reload, OS unload and rejected-save navigation branches remain automated/source coverage.

findings.native: Selected-page loading/generation and canonical assignment safeguards passed delayed async fixtures; no native Add was raced against a loading page.
findings.limits: Native delayed loading, stale page completion and incomplete catalogue races were not induced; the protected Add path is automated-only.

findings.native: Native Validate Schemas changed to Checking, completed with schemas ready, and re-enabled the control.
findings.limits: Healthy native validation observed. Schema rejection, conflict refresh/dismiss rejection and repeated pending invocation were mocked production-handler tests; failure recovery is not a native fault-injection PASS.

findings.native: Native scale toolbar displayed Add Page fully in fixed page actions outside the horizontally scrolling tab strip. Final normal native 1024×768 Back Office also displayed Royal, Conference, Grapes, Lemons, Limes, tomato and watermelon prices fully. Toolbar actions remained visible and page chips scrolled independently.
findings.limits: Original Add Page clipping and final square-screen tile-price-row regressions passed in native Tauri. This does not certify all screen sizes, extreme product names, translations or font/zoom settings; delayed page assignment races are automated-only.

findings.limits: Observed permission tab layout passed. No permissions were changed; every role/translation/zoom variant is not certified.

findings.limits: Observed unchecked-rule label passed. No barcode rule was persisted; parser/rule-matching edge cases remain automated coverage.

findings.native: Native Change Price used touch Delete last digit to change 169p → 16p, then physical Backspace to change 16p → 1p. Cancel retained the item's original 169p price.
findings.limits: Observed touch/keyboard deletion and cancellation passed. This is not every key sequence or completed discounted/return sale combination.

findings.limits: Observed ordinary weighed calculation and genuine override distinction passed. Historical lines with incomplete metadata retain only distinctions supported by stored data; not every return/legacy line was native checked.

findings.limits: Observed cash-only detail passed. Mixed card/cash, cashback, negative return allocations and every legacy tender shape were not native UI tested.

findings.native: Native period-report preview displayed a visible close X and the close control worked.
findings.limits: Observed preview icon/close workflow passed. Every theme, focus style, font scaling and save-busy close guard is not a complete native visual matrix.

findings.limits: Native search/detail passed on the small existing history. Traversal beyond 50 receipts is actual SQLite fixture evidence, not a native >50-record scenario. Product names are current catalogue names, not historical snapshots. Final native stock count/save restoration is separately recorded under AUDIT-05.

nativeScenarios.title: Pay Later: native original-receipt timeout recovery
nativeScenarios.evidence: Controlled native Pay Later acquisition timed out after 5,003ms and retained reserved receipt 1000085. The alert and persistent banner said pending verification, not cancelled. Review showed the original customer, one item and 169p. Recover completed and verified that same receipt: database proof showed exactly one order and one 169p account charge; total orders 91, pending financial journals 0. A normal 169p repayment restored balance 0p and the original hold. The final normal app was rebuilt without the test fault flag.
nativeScenarios.limits: Separately requested original P1 regression, not an extra finding in the remaining-36 count. Mock data; one controlled failure/replay path, not every crash/network boundary.

nativeScenarios.limits: Observed delete/cancel workflow, not every pad key or completed price-override sale.
